# results

Immutable UTF-8 observations retained by one run's briefing. Model-facing references select data before an ordinary action proposal reaches Commission admission; they never grant an action, carry authority, execute expressions, or stand in for verified evidence.

`intake.results` is one of intake's bounded contexts. [All domains](./index.mdx).

## Types

### `Capture`

`intake.results.Capture` is one of `Complete` and `Partial`.

### `Rendering`

`intake.results.Rendering` is one of `Text` and `Json`.

### `ResultReference`

`intake.results.ResultReference` is a record of four fields:

- `result` — `String`
- `sha256` — `String`
- `select` — `intake.results.ResultSelector`
- `rendering` — `intake.results.Rendering`

### `ResultSelector`

`intake.results.ResultSelector` is a record of four fields:

- `kind` — `intake.results.SelectionKind`
- `start` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent
- `end` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent
- `pointer` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent

### `SelectionKind`

`intake.results.SelectionKind` is one of `Whole`, `Bytes`, `Lines` and `JsonPointer`.

### `StoredResult`

`intake.results.StoredResult` is a record of five fields:

- `result_id` — `String`
- `sha256` — `String`
- `origin` — `String`
- `capture` — `intake.results.Capture`
- `utf8_bytes` — `Integer`

One of the types above is reached by nothing else in this system: `intake.results.ResultReference`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names it, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
